svg.title: 04c-self-consistency
svg.desc: Schematic spatial self-energy matrices and the full-range SCBA requirement. The seven-by-seven blocks indicate which spatial matrix blocks are allowed, not numerical matrix values or calculated nonzero entries. Teal blocks lie in an illustrative finite-support band. Orange dashed hollow blocks on the left are omitted cross-region contributions when the spatially constructed self-energy is used directly as final. Complete local supports can overlap, so the constructed matrix may be banded rather than diagonal; the illustrated bandwidth and block count are arbitrary teaching choices, not a production support cutoff. The right matrix allows the outside-band blocks and is coupled to a full-device Green-function/self-energy iteration. Removing this spatial restriction requires evaluating all retained-model region pairs s,t at every SCBA update, including cross-region terms. Repeating an update restricted to same-region pairs would not restore excluded terms. This panel states the full-range calculation required to remove the spatial-pair approximation; it does not claim that the displayed silicon benchmarks already used unrestricted region pairs. Cubic Born truncation and the chosen force-constant model remain separate approximations. No atoms, trajectories, spectra or numerical self-energy values are drawn.

g.text: a Use constructed Σ as final
Include cross-region pairs in every SCBA update.
